Which protocol is used to send e-mail?
A) FTP
B) SMTP
C) HTTP
D) SSH
ANSWER: B

What is the past tense of 'go'?
A) goed
B) gone
C) went
D) going
ANSWER: C

Which data structure works on the LIFO principle?
A) queue
B) stack
C) tree
D) graph
ANSWER: B

What is 7 × 8?
A) 54
B) 56
C) 58
D) 64
ANSWER: B

Which ocean lies between Europe and North America?
A) Pacific
B) Indian
C) Atlantic
D) Arctic
ANSWER: C
